cat > /app/meeting_scheduled.ics <<'EOF'
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Terminal-Bench//Meeting Scheduler//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:REQUEST
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-20240117T110000Z@example.com
DTSTAMP:20240110T090000Z
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:1-hour team planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol
LOCATION:Conference Room A
ORGANIZER;CN=Alice:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Carol;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:carol@example.com
STATUS:CONFIRMED
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
cd /app && python3 -c "
import re,datetime
def ev(f):
    t=open(f).read();return [(datetime.datetime.strptime(a,'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'),datetime.datetime.strptime(b,'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')) for a,b in re.findall(r'DTSTART:(\S+)\s+DTEND:(\S+)',t)]
busy={n:ev(n+'_calendar.ics') for n in ('alice','bob','carol')}
m=ev('meeting_scheduled.ics')[0]
print(m, (m[1]-m[0]))
for n,es in busy.items():
    print(n,[e for e in es if e[0]<m[1] and e[1]>m[0]])
" && ls -l meeting_scheduled.ics && md5sum *.ics
